exam_scheme.note: The Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), a premier R&D society of the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), recruits Project Engineers through a multi-stage selection process. Stage 1 is an Online Written Test / CBT of 120 minutes duration consisting of Section A (General Aptitude, English proficiency, Logical Reasoning - 50 questions, 50 marks) and Section B (Domain Engineering, including Algorithms, Data Structures, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Computer Networks, and VLSI/Embedded Systems - 100 questions, 100 marks). Shortlisted candidates based on written test cutoffs proceed to Stage 2: a Technical and Personal Interview conducted by domain specialist committees.

financial_package.note: Project Engineers at C-DAC are recruited on consolidated contractual emoluments benchmarked to the 7th CPC Level 10 entry scale. Starting consolidated pay ranges from ₹44,900 to ₹56,100 per month (CTC approx. ₹6.5 Lakhs to ₹9.0 Lakhs per annum depending on qualifications, center location, and project grant funding). Employees are provided medical cover, group life insurance, and annual performance-based increments.
